title: Four gas-combustion datasets take 0.5 MJ of gas per MJ burned but emit the CO₂ of 1 MJ

observation: One gas input of 0.5 MJ per MJ burned. The other 34 datasets of this name take 1.0 MJ, and all 38 emit 0.0561 kg fossil CO₂, the CO₂ of 1 MJ. The workbook scores the four 11.3 % (LU, LT, RME) and 15.4 % (KR) below their same-supplier siblings, which is the missing half of the supply chain. Eleven datasets consume them directly.
method: Measured on all 38 datasets of the name in the ecoSpold XML of 2025 v2 and 2026 v1 and on the LCIA workbook; filed 31 October 2026. Not yet re-measured by a second person.

next.action: A second person repeats the measurement on BAFU's release files. Then the finding is reported to BAFU.
